message: nature `{name}` derives from `{parent}` and so always inherits its `access` function ({access}), which LRM §3.6.1.2 forbids it from changing to `{new_access}`
description: A derived nature always has its parent's access function; the standard forbids changing it.
actions: Remove the `access` attribute from the derived nature, or declare an independent nature instead of a derived one.
